The site is Lantern Works Fan Registry — Stop-Motion Craft Archive & Moderation Queue, a fan-community-site web application for Lantern Works stop-motion craft archive and moderated contribution registry.

Owner brief: "Lantern Works Fan Registry is a community-curated archive of stop-motion animation puppets, miniature sets, and production ephemera where fan contributions pass through a moderator queue. Build the collection browser and contribution submission form so members can submit an artefact entry to the server and verify its recorded status after reloading."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-38/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Lantern Works Fan Registry — Stop-Motion Craft Archive & Moderation Queue: the page for Lantern Works stop-motion craft archive and moderated contribution registry, in a dark, low-glare palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #18131a (lw-bg), #261f29 (lw-surface), #312736 (lw-card), #3d3142 (lw-border), #d97706 (lw-brass), #faf5ff (lw-cream), #c4b5fd (lw-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 10px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--lw-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: an unmoderated submission shown publicly before a moderator decision; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Lantern Works Fan Registry — Stop-Motion Craft Archive & Moderation Queue as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Artefact title", "Contributor handle", "Canon section", "Archival & lighting notes").

User journey context: Browse the Lantern Works stop-motion canon collection by section (Characters, Sets and Props, Ephemera, Interviews). Complete the contribution composer with artefact title, contributor handle, canon section, and archival notes. Submit the contribution for moderation and reload the contribution status page to confirm it is saved on the server.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
